scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.mobile:setup: npm run build && cap add android && node scripts/configure-android-user-agent.cjs
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios:setup: npm run build && cap add ios && cap sync ios
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:ios:setup && cap open ios
